fullContentHtml:
NVS Class 6 Admission Admit Card 2027 – Full Details

Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), has released the Admit Card for the Navodaya Vidyalaya JNV Selection Test for Class VI (2027- 28) on the official website of the NVS recently. Online registration process for NVS Class 6 Admission 2027 were accepted from 07 July 2026 to 10 August 2026. The Exam is going to conducted on 28 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NVS Class 6th Admit Card 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 July 2026
  • Last Date : 10 August 2026 (Extended)
  • Exam Date (Summer Bound) : 28 November 2026
  • Admit Card : 28 October 2026
  • Result Declared : March / April 2027

Application Fee

  • There is no Application Fee for all categories

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Download Admit Card
  • Apply Online (Registration)
  • Apply Online (Login)
  • Print Registration Form
  • Find Registration Number
  • Download Notification

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is NVS Class 6 Admission Admit Card 2027?

NVS Class 6 Admission Admit Card 2027 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
